source: cutwork/tools/treatment.py as of 2026-08-05, extracted 2026-08-11 (tool moves to tools/stylize-frames.py in Task 8)
note: Defaults are the 2026-07-02 'washed-out verdict' corrections — the knobs exist because the first treatment was too weak. Blender 5.x compositor node group; every frame gets the identical graph (no diffusion boil).
graph: MovieClip ─┬─ Kuwahara ─ Blur ─ Glare(Bloom) ─ HueSat(desat) ─ Curves(tonal) ─┐ └─ Filter(Sobel) ─ Curves(threshold) ─ Blur ─ Invert ─ Mix(MULTIPLY ink) ─ [paper Mix] ─ GroupOut

shadow.meaning: shadow-crush target at input 0.30 (lower = blacker floor)

gotchas.menuSockets: Blender 5.x menu sockets take title-case labels ('Bloom', 'Sobel', 'Render Size') — lowercase silently falls through set_socket's except and the knob is NEVER APPLIED, which is a silent look change.
gotchas.vectorSockets: Blur 'Size' is a vector socket; set via set_socket's component handling, not a scalar assign.
gotchas.audio: Blender drops audio. Mux the source back: ffmpeg -i OUT.mp4 -i INPUT.mov -c:v copy -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -shortest OUT_av.mp4
